verdicts.reason: A turns the layout into a proper left-to-right banner. The striped panel holds a readable '48H ONLY' badge and the box, and the headline and CTA are clear. Its flaws: the badge crowds the box, and the body copy is tiny and lower-contrast at this size. B shrinks the '48H ONLY' badge to an unreadable pink dot that collides with the box, so the urgency message is lost. Its body copy also wraps to leave the orphan 'stock.', and the oversized CTA competes with a smaller headline, which weakens the hierarchy.
